rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the owner's blind review of the holdout18 sample (0 hard defects) and three prompt additions made in response (safety rules stated as rules, injury first, state a limit and hand off for exceptions); never use it to tune.
A run on this set is a gate. Any edit to holdout19.json changes the hash and must be a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze with a new date and a note here.
Disjoint from development.json, evaluation.json and holdout through holdout18 (ids, domains, business questions).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4). noDenial cases assume the case's own knowledge is silent on the asked offering.
supersedes: holdout18 (consumed 2026-11-03: 8/8 valid; owner review 0 hard defects, 6 action items).
